newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads stable to U.S.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads stable to U.S.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads were little changed against the U.S. during a thinly traded session as the market unwound for the year-end holidays, traders said.

U.S. Treasuries weakened on Wednesday following a disappointing result to a two-year bond auction, causing concern over potential interest for a five-year note sale later today, and with little local focus, domestic bonds generally followed the trend.
However, the local market slightly outperformed Canadian debt, which came under pressure following Wednesday's stronger than expected Canadian CPI.
New Zealand bonds were more perkier, outpacing the local market as it took to heart a rise in the N.Z. dollar.
